NAY 20, 2026
ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 7-F in the area bounded by:
A line 50 feet north of and parallel to West Drummond Place; the public
alley next east of and parallel to North Clark Street; West Drummond
Place; and North Clark Street;

to those of a B3-5 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2701 North Clark Street
